description.en: Fades an object's (typically an image's) alpha from a start value to an end value over a number of frames, interpolating frame by frame via CMND_SET_ALPHA.
Handle of the object to fade.
Duration of the fade, in frames.
The elapsed frame count when the fade finished (approximately equal to _frm).

example.code:
// Fade an image in over 20 frames
ObjFade(hImg[1], 20);
